title: Layout
slide_intent: Signal the shift from individual identity elements to decisions about composing them. Readers can find the section where the elements begin to work together.
strategic_value: Instacart can mark this transition using the same dark green chapter treatment introduced for the individual element families.
demonstration: A large cream Layout title on dark green introduces the section, with small book identifiers along the top.
practical_value: Use this divider as the starting point for the composition rules that follow.

content_islands.name: Running identifiers
content_islands.spec: Place the book label, version and folio at the top with consistent alignment.

content_islands.name: Section title
content_islands.spec: Set Layout large and left aligned on the dark green field. Leave the remainder of the divider open.
